model.architecture: IBM Granite 4.0-h hybrid: 28 Mamba2 selective-scan blocks interleaved with 4 grouped-query attention blocks; per-layer conv + SSM recurrent state instead of a growing KV cache

variants.quantization: fp16 weights (float-casting on linears + embedding; convs and the SSM stay fp32)
known_issues: CPU only, for two independent reasons. The same rank-5/6 scan graph as _int8 above, and - even after that is rewritten - float-casting EMBEDDING_LOOKUP leaves empty quantization params plus a DEQUANTIZE the delegate will not take (3326 of 3536 ops, engine refused). There is no fp16 GPU variant; use _int8_gpu.
The CPU runtime unpacks fp16 weights to fp32 in RAM (~3.7 GB peak on iPhone vs ~2.1 GB for int8) - treat fp16 as the desktop/quality variant.

variants.quantization: int8 dynamic weight-only (linears + embedding; convs and the SSM stay float)
known_issues: Cannot create a GPU engine: this export writes the Mamba2 SSD contractions as broadcast-multiply-reduce, materialising rank-5 and rank-6 intermediates that every mobile GPU delegate refuses. On a Galaxy S26 the delegate takes 109 of 3673 ops and the runtime refuses the partial split - use the _int8_gpu file for the same weights on GPU.
Engine state reuse: chat-templated lengths 33-37 (LiteRT-LM#3165); a fresh Engine per conversation is clean.

variants.quantization: int8 dynamic weight-only (linears + embedding; convs and the SSM stay float), fp32 activations declared

platform_notes: Requires litert-lm >= 0.15: the hybrid conv/SSM state buffers bind through the ExecutorMetadata section, which the 0.14 engine does not read
The bundle does not prepend a BOS token, matching Granite's official chat template; at 350M scale a prepended <|end_of_text|> measurably degrades greedy answers
On a Galaxy S26 the GPU path wins prefill and loses decode - pick the backend by workload, not by assuming GPU is faster

measured.source: S5 same-device CPU control, identical prompt file and flags; phone already warm from the GPU runs

known_issues: Engine state reuse, not quantization: reusing one Engine across conversations whose prompts share a growing common prefix can end a reply after a few tokens, on this file at chat-templated lengths 37-41 (LiteRT-LM#3165). A fresh Engine per conversation is clean at every length tested, 35-45.
GPU peak memory is about twice the CPU path's (2131 MB vs 1105 MB on the S26 benchmark).
